fields.acceptance: A testscript (cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/model-commit-untracked.txtar) with a local bare origin and a fake gh leaves orphan entries of two change sets plus one entry held by a live run, runs rhiza model commit-untracked and asserts two model branches with one PR each and the held entry untouched; go test ./internal/api -run 'TestDaemonCommitsUntracked' asserts a due daemon round (the first poll) does the same, not every tick
fields.statement: rhiza model commit-untracked finds the untracked .rhiza/log entries in the main checkout that no pending model branch or live run holds and commits them onto one model branch per change set with a model-only PR, as a main-checkout write does; the daemon does the same on its first poll and then at most once a minute per project (modelNetEvery), each git or gh program it runs for this killed after modelNetTimeout (30s) and run with GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 so it never waits on a credential prompt
